tldr: Venus in the 10th house: love becomes personal through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
body:
With Venus in the 10th house, this part of you moves through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction. Venus describes love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, and what makes connection feel worth choosing. In practice, this brings attention to the work, responsibilities, goals, and public roles that shape how you are seen.

When this placement is supported, your direction can become more visible, accountable, and real. Venus can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support.

When it is strained, achievement or approval can start carrying too much of your identity. The harder pattern can show up as people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support expressed through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
challenge: people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval around career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
